escalations.label: dualPhaseTiles ≥ 1 (dispatch's fourth named gate)
escalations.detail: dualPhaseTiles=0 is FORCED to 0 on a portal-free board: the grid is bipartite and every legal move changes x+y parity and the phase together, so the phase at a tile is a function of the tile (ADR-0009 decision 1 — a switch never relocates the player, so the latch cannot break it). No portal-free level before L11 can satisfy the gate as written; ADR-0009 schedules M2 at L11. (Guard: portal-free AND measured 0 — if either stops holding this verdict becomes PASS/FAIL.)

generatedFrom.hashInput: canonical JSON of each parsed level file (object keys sorted recursively, whitespace-insensitive) — a content hash, not a git sha, so the report is reproducible across worktrees
